project: Wuxia Life P89 Medical Payoff Playable Implementation
description: Implement the medical payoff stage for medical_sage_healer tavern_hand seed — 2 choice events (compassionate + pragmatic), 6 total branches with full expression updates (cost label, current goal, age-40 identity, life memory, summary), targeted proof, and regression tests. Strictly follows P88 payoff contract.

Group 4: Pragmatic 3 choices post-payoff — flags + stats + cost label + current goal
